messages:
alex: RCA published for last night's service degradation. Link: https://internal.redwood.com/postmortem/2723456789
alex: TL;DR: cache eviction + autoscaler race caused spike, fallback didn't engage quickly enough. Major user impact ~45m between 02:12-02:57 UTC.
alex: Key actions (owners and due dates):
- priya: add stronger cache eviction guardrails (due 2026-04-01)
- ben: autoscaler debounce + unit tests (due 2026-03-30)
- jules: update runbook and rollback playbook (due 2026-03-26)
- eng_oncall: verify fallbacks and add monitoring alert (due 2026-03-24)
alex: Office hours to review and handoff: Wed 2026-03-25 16:00 PT. Invite sent.
ops-bot: RCA doc uploaded and linked in #postmortems: https://internal.redwood.com/postmortem/2723456789 :white_check_mark:
priya: reading it now. will start draft changes for eviction config tomorrow.
ben: will PR autoscaler patch today, cc @alex
jules: thanks — I'll spin up the office hours agenda and share notes.
eng_oncall: ran the failover test from the doc — 2/3 steps succeeded, need to fix probe timing.
sara: can we add an SLA regression guard to prevent silent latency increases?
alex: good call @sara — adding as follow-up. priya, please estimate effort.
priya: estimate ~1-2 days; I'll add to the doc.
mike: FYI: customer success already emailed impacted customers; we're offering credits where eligible.
alex: thanks @mike. we'll coordinate messaging for the postmortem summary.
ben: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/autoscaler/pull/432
priya: pushed draft for cache guardrails to the doc — please review: https://internal.redwood.com/drafts/eviction-guard
jules: calendar invite updated with agenda and video link.
alex: action owners — please update the doc's "status" field as you make progress. we'll do a 1-week checkpoint on 2026-03-31.
sara: noted. will add monitoring query for SLA regression alerting.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-03-31 10:00 UTC — 1-week checkpoint
alex: thanks everyone. closing the incident channel; follow-ups here.
priya: quick question — do we need an opt-in for tighter eviction thresholds per-customer?
jules: let's discuss during office hours; tentative: global default stricter, opt-out per customer.
ben: added unit tests and load sim results to PR.
sara: :thumbsup:
eng_oncall: tagging myself as owner for fallback tests in the doc.
alex: last note — I assigned 'severity blameless retrospective' session next Monday, optional for anyone who wants to join.
